notes: RMG, Rosalie's Mupen GUI (N64): pkgforge-dev's sharun repackaging, as melonDS. mupen64plus core with the GLideN64 video plugin, which is OpenGL ES and runs on every board: gopher64/paraLLEl-RDP needs 8- and 16-bit SSBO storage the A610 (SM6115) lacks in hardware -- forcing the Turnip flags locks the GPU up (HW 2026-10-20, Air X). RMG replaced gopher64 for that reason; its own parallel video plugin is not the default, but options.json offers it (with the parallel RSP) for the A7xx boards.
-f: fullscreen; -n hides the menubar, toolbar and statusbar; -q quits RMG when emulation ends (otherwise the game's exit leaves RMG's ROM browser). {rom} boots at once. ROMs: n64/v64/z64 + zip/7z.
gui_args: RMG's own window (ROM browser and settings), for Main menu > Emulators > Open.

SDL_NO_SIGNAL_HANDLERS=1: RMG-Input initialises SDL, whose SIGTERM handler would turn OpenGamepadUI's Exit into an SDL quit event RMG's Qt loop never reads (the melonDS lesson). The seed also turns ConfirmExitWhileInGame off: a confirm dialog would hang that same Exit.

Saves and save states: the seed points SaveSRAMPath/SaveStatePath at ~/saves/n64 and ~/states/n64 directly (mupen64plus.cfg [Core]); no tmpfiles links needed. gopher64's old saves in there are not RMG-compatible (different naming); games start fresh.

gamepad_profile guide-hotkeys.yaml: hold Guide for L1 load state, R1 save state (current slot), R2 speed limiter off/on (a toggle: RMG has no hold fast-forward), Start stop -- as keyboard F1-F4, bound in the seeded mupen64plus.cfg [Rosalie's Mupen GUI KeyBindings]. Guide+Start is the same Shutdown action as Select + Start, so -q quits RMG through its normal exit.
